name: create_snapshot
description:
Create a new Cloud Pub/Sub snapshot from a given subscription.

**Important Notes**

*   A snapshot is a named resource that captures the acknowledgment state of messages in an
    existing subscription to allow for managing acknowledgments in bulk.

*   Snapshots are used in Seek operations to manage message acknowledgments in bulk.

snapshotProjectId.description: Required. The project ID that the snapshot should be created in.

subscriptionId.description: Required. The ID of the subscription whose backlog the snapshot retains.

subscriptionProjectId.description: Required. The project ID the subscription is in.

tags.description: Optional. Input only. Immutable. Tag keys/values directly bound to this resource. For example: "123/environment": "production", "123/costCenter": "marketing" See https://{$universe.dns_names.final_documentation_domain}/pubsub/docs/tags for more information on using tags with Pub/Sub resources.
